scoring_method: STT rubric scoring on blinded A/B outputs, applying the frozen case-specific four binary checks; critical violations, material claims, counterexample handling and alternative distinctness scored separately. This is a measurement method, not an independent-review/approval gate. Material-claim counts are conservative manual counts; unsupported claims counted where assertions are not supported by supplied case facts.

A.notes: Checks scored in listed order; 0/4 directly satisfied. Unsupported-claim counts conservatively reflect material assertions not supported by case facts.
